COLDWAR_SOV_gosplan_directives.problem: The economy root gave a single 2 % construction line plus the decision unlock, about half a cost-3 budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_complete_the_eighth_plan.problem: Completing the most successful plan of the era paid for one factory and one 3 % line, far below a cost-5 reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_kosygin_reform_question.problem: The reform question hub gave only 25 PP; a choice hub needs a small real reward reflecting the 1965 reform already in place.

COLDWAR_SOV_deepen_the_kosygin_reform.problem: Two faction losses outweighed two modifier lines, so the flagship reform focus was nearly worthless despite its political price.

COLDWAR_SOV_enterprise_self_financing.problem: Two downsides (unions and stability) for two lines left khozraschyot well under budget; the union loss alone is the logical price.

COLDWAR_SOV_lessons_from_budapest.problem: Studying Hungary's New Economic Mechanism gave only an opinion and two small lines; it should improve productivity and ties with the socialist partners.

COLDWAR_SOV_legalise_the_cooperatives.problem: A cost-7 payoff that only swapped one idea against a faction loss; the cooperatives should also fill the civilian gaps and open Imperia's Worker Co-operatives idea.

COLDWAR_SOV_cybernetic_planning.problem: OGAS was paid with money and a faction loss but returned only one line and a single tech use.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_ogas_network.problem: The nationwide computer network built one under-priced office and paid an extra GDP charge, giving a cost-7 focus about a third of its budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_kantorovich_optimal_prices.problem: Optimal pricing gave two lines against a faction loss; linear programming should raise tax yield and computing as well.

COLDWAR_SOV_computing_centres_of_the_rep.problem: Computing centres in every republic built nothing and gave half a cost-7 budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_ministries_restored.problem: Restoring the branch ministries gave one construction line that its own productivity cost cancelled out.

COLDWAR_SOV_new_union_ministries.problem: New specialised ministries (instruments, fertilisers, gas) gave one line against a bureaucracy cost line, a net zero.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_tolkachi.problem: The fixers' efficiency line was exactly offset by the corruption line, so a cost-5 focus gave nothing net.

COLDWAR_SOV_plan_fulfilment_campaigns.problem: Plan campaigns were under budget; they are the Soviet form of Imperia's National Labour Mobilization idea, which now gets a discount window.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_ninth_five_year_plan.problem: Adopting the Ninth Plan at the XXIV Congress gave only 50 PP for a cost-5 focus.

COLDWAR_SOV_group_b_goods_for_the_people.problem: The consumer-goods priority built no consumer factory and stayed under budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_brezhnevka.problem: The housing programme paid an over-priced road level and a social-cost line for small stability; housing should show in stability and population growth.

COLDWAR_SOV_refrigerators_and_television.problem: Appliances for every family were a cost-3-sized reward on a cost-5 focus.

COLDWAR_SOV_group_a_means_of_production.problem: Heavy-industry priority was under budget and its two factories were under-priced.

COLDWAR_SOV_steel_cities.problem: Expanding Magnitogorsk and Cherepovets added steel and one road-type building but no steelworks.

COLDWAR_SOV_machine_building_first.problem: Machine-tool priority was under budget and built no plant.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_defence_sector_first.problem: Defence priority was under budget and its two arms factories were under-priced.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_nine_ministries.problem: Tighter control of the nine defence ministries gave two lines; it should also raise arms-factory output and build capacity.

COLDWAR_SOV_dual_use_factories.problem: Consumer goods from arms plants were under budget and gave no visible relief to the shops.

COLDWAR_SOV_avtovaz_the_zhiguli.problem: The giant Togliatti plant was one over-priced factory and one line.

COLDWAR_SOV_kamaz_the_kama_truck_works.problem: One of the great projects of the decade gave one over-priced factory and two small bonuses at cost 7.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_price_question.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_raise_retail_prices.problem: The heavy price (stability -6 %, unions -10) left the price reform worth nothing; honest prices should fill the budget once and keep the yield.

COLDWAR_SOV_hold_the_prices.problem: Holding prices gave less stability than its own two cost lines; the social contract should pay in stability and union loyalty at the price of subsidies.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_unified_system_question.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_ryad_copy_the_ibm_360.problem: The joint Comecon computer family was under budget; the partners should share in it.

COLDWAR_SOV_continue_the_besm_line.problem: The expensive independent line (cost 7) gave less than the cheaper Ryad copy; independence from Western designs should pay in research and sanction resistance.

COLDWAR_SOV_microelectronics_of_zelenogr.problem: Zelenograd built one chip plant with one tech use at cost 7.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_tenth_five_year_plan.problem: The Plan of Efficiency and Quality gave 50 PP and one line at cost 5.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_shchekino_method.problem: Two downsides outweighed the single productivity line; the method frees workers for new plants, the union loss is the logical price.

COLDWAR_SOV_quality_mark_of_the_ussr.problem: The State Quality Mark was under budget and did not improve the goods themselves.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_1979_economic_mechanism.problem: The 1979 decree gave two lines at cost 5.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_scientific_technical_rev.problem: The economy capstone (cost 10) gave about half its budget: no buildings and no technology.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_agrarian_problem.problem: The agriculture root gave 15 PP and one line, below the hub minimum.

COLDWAR_SOV_pour_capital_into_the_kolkho.problem: Paying twice (an agriculture district at double price plus a GDP charge) for one line; the money should show in farms, roads and procurement prices.

COLDWAR_SOV_fertiliser_and_machinery.problem: Fertiliser plants and tractor works built an agriculture district at double price and nothing industrial.

COLDWAR_SOV_land_melioration.problem: The programme that adds millions of hectares paid GDP for one line and created no farmland.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_non_black_earth_programm.problem: The orthodox branch payoff (cost 7) paid double for two districts and lost cohesion for one line.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_link_system.problem: Agricultural labour need -10 % alone cancels the whole start malus in one focus (five times MD's typical line); halved to keep the branch meaningful.

COLDWAR_SOV_enlarge_the_private_plots.problem: Private plots feed a quarter of the nation but the focus was under budget; the orthodox grumbling was not shown.

COLDWAR_SOV_kolkhoz_markets.problem: Slightly under budget; free markets should also improve supply in the cities.

COLDWAR_SOV_contract_farming.problem: The reform branch payoff (cost 7) gave one line plus a small party gain.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_harvest_of_1972.problem: Note-only crisis hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_buy_grain_abroad.problem: Paying 1 % of GDP for +3 % stability made the purchase a net loss; the Great Grain Robbery was cheap and should feed the livestock too. A US player's economic sanctions now raise the price (Imperia hook).

COLDWAR_SOV_tighten_the_belts.problem: The focus consisted only of downsides; keeping the hard currency should pay in money saved and political will.

COLDWAR_SOV_virgin_lands_renewal.problem: Renewing the virgin lands paid double for one district and gave one line.

COLDWAR_SOV_white_gold.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_irrigate_the_desert.problem: The canals created no farmland and the later Aral Sea crisis (event) was a hidden downside.

COLDWAR_SOV_save_the_aral_sea.problem: Saving the sea had only costs; modern irrigation should raise yields and the saved fishing towns stability.

COLDWAR_SOV_turn_the_siberian_rivers.problem: The cost-10 capstone gave one line for 3 % of GDP and three downsides, a large net loss.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_food_programme.problem: Slightly under budget for cost 7; the agro-industrial complexes built nothing.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_tyumen_complex.problem: Roads, power lines and cities in the permafrost were one over-priced road level.

COLDWAR_SOV_gas_for_pipes.problem: The offer focus gave nothing of our own; preparing gas exports should improve our own export income (the partner's part stays in the offer).

COLDWAR_SOV_urengoy.problem: The largest gas field in the world added no resource; Yamalo-Nenets gets gas (oil in MD) like MD's Arctic gas foci.

COLDWAR_SOV_petrodollars.problem: The flat windfall handed the AI money in a world without an oil shock; the payment now reads the real oil price ratio (player-made, read-only) and the petrodollars fund aid capacity.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_atomic_power_programme.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_rbmk_reactors.problem: The accident risk behind the RBMK flag (event after 1975) was a hidden downside; it is now stated.

COLDWAR_SOV_vver_reactors.problem: The safer, dearer reactor paid GDP for one line and built no reactor.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_leningrad_station.problem: The flagship station was a single over-priced reactor at cost 7; nuclear power should also lower oil dependency (Imperia).

COLDWAR_SOV_atoms_for_the_republics.problem: Stations in four republics were a single over-priced reactor at cost 7.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_great_siberian_dams.problem: The largest dams in the world built one renewable plant and gave nothing to hydro power or the Siberian smelters.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_baikal_amur_mainline.problem: The project of the century charged 2 % of GDP and placed three unpaid road levels for a cost-10 reward of under 3 points; its Imperia road upkeep was not shown.

COLDWAR_SOV_bam_open_to_traffic.problem: Its two road levels were unpaid and the opening of the line gave little at cost 7.

COLDWAR_SOV_kuzbass_and_ekibastuz.problem: The coal backbone of the east built one over-priced building and no power station.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_unified_energy_system.problem: The grid of the whole Union and Comecon built one over-priced building at cost 7.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_academy_of_sciences.problem: The science root gave one line and 15 PP; links to industry were not rewarded.

COLDWAR_SOV_akademgorodok.problem: The science town's institute was an office at half price; computing and education gains were small.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_naukograds.problem: The research facility was unpaid; the closed cities should advance nuclear and missile research.

COLDWAR_SOV_genetics_rehabilitated.problem: The 2000s genetics category misses the 1960s-70s genetics techs; the bonus now also targets Early Genetics (Imperia/Cold War techs) and the institutes add research.

code: add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_SOV_genetics_rehabilitated bonus = 0.5 uses = 2 category = CAT_genetics technology = mdcw_genetic_code_1966 technology = mdcw_recombinant_dna_1973 }

COLDWAR_SOV_scientific_exchange.problem: The research gain was cancelled by the drift-defence cost; contacts with the West should also bring trade and technology.

COLDWAR_SOV_venera.problem: The first landing on another planet gave one programme step and 1 % research at cost 5.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_n1_moon_rocket.problem: 1.5 % of GDP bought one programme step and one tech use: a cost-7 focus worth zero.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_soviet_moonshot.problem: The capstone cost 2.5 % of GDP for two programme steps and a timed idea, net negative for cost 10.

COLDWAR_SOV_soyuz_apollo.problem: The offer focus gave nothing of our own; the Soyuz flight itself should advance the programme.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_space_shuttle_answer.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_energia_buran.problem: The most expensive programme (3 % GDP) returned one project step and one tech use, net negative at cost 10.

COLDWAR_SOV_mir_station.problem: The permanent station with international guests was under budget at cost 7.

COLDWAR_SOV_eyes_in_orbit.problem: Reconnaissance satellites gave half a cost-5 budget and nothing to intelligence.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_scientific_superpower.problem: The science payoff (cost 7) gave one idea and 2 % stability.

COLDWAR_SOV_andropovs_kgb.problem: The KGB root gave one line and +5, half a cost-3 budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_fifth_directorate.problem: Slightly under budget, and the chilling effect on intellectual life described in the focus was not shown.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_dissident_question.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_exile_and_expulsion.problem: Only an idea swap and an event at cost 5.

COLDWAR_SOV_tolerate_the_samizdat.problem: Tolerance cost the KGB's loyalty but did not show the promised softer Western opinion or the scientists' freedom.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_refusenik_question.problem: Note-only choice hub without any real reward.

COLDWAR_SOV_open_the_gates.problem: Under budget; the trade and credits of detente were only half rewarded. It also contradicted the Cold War Border Regime idea (Imperia/CW hook).

COLDWAR_SOV_the_diploma_tax.problem: The tax yielded 0.1 % of GDP against a -10 % trade line, a net loss; it should bring hard currency and keep the specialists.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_first_chief_directorate.problem: Slightly under budget; MD intelligence foci always win the service's favour.

COLDWAR_SOV_active_measures.problem: Radio Moscow and Service A match the Cold War idea International Broadcasting Service, which now gets a discount window (Imperia/CW hook).

COLDWAR_SOV_kgb_border_troops.problem: The longest frontier in the world gave two small items; the Border Troops match the Cold War idea Border Regime and Exit Controls (Imperia/CW hook).

COLDWAR_SOV_operation_ryan.problem: Under budget; the worldwide watch should improve intelligence and readiness.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_anti_corruption_drive.problem: The campaign at cost 7 gave less than half its budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_the_shield_and_the_sword.problem: The KGB payoff (cost 7) gave one idea and +5.
